node.html: Predicting EGFR mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma directly from routine H&E slides, so that patients without access to molecular testing can still be triaged for targeted therapy. I built the end-to-end pipeline at DataPathology, from slide tiling to attention-based multiple instance learning, and I'm adapting it to Moroccan and African patient cohorts.

My PhD asks a simple question: does an immune biomarker stay true when the patients, scanners and hospitals change? I'm developing methods to quantify tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes from whole-slide images and testing whether they stay reliable across populations and imaging sources. First presented at the CCAIM ML for Healthcare Summer School, Cambridge.
